title: NYSDEC data check
purpose: Run an optional read-only check of current next-version data before committing it to an issued report.

sections.title: Access and scope
paragraphs: Project managers, approvers, users with explicit release authority and operational admins can configure and generate EDDs. Other internal roles can read EDD checks but cannot save settings or generate files. Client accounts cannot open these staff pages.

Exploratory NYSDEC chemistry EDD v5 input, format 5.0.0.079 with reference values 20260429. The application checks only its known required fields, lengths, numeric/date formats, enumerations and keys. It does not contain recipient reference tables or validate those codes. Load generated files into EQuIS EDP, resolve its errors, and use EDP’s signing/submission process. No recipient acceptance or compliance is claimed.

Uses the report’s live assembled content and current mappings. It creates no report version, export, setting or audit record and does not change receipt or PDF release eligibility. Reload after source fixes. The same page can check an amendment draft.

Text values beginning with =, +, -, @, a tab or a carriage return block EDD generation because a spreadsheet may interpret them as formulas. Numeric columns, including negative results, are not subject to this text check. Values are never escaped, prefixed or rewritten in the deliverable. Correct inaccurate source text through its normal correction workflow; if it is already frozen in an issued report, an amended report version is needed. If the recorded value is accurate and cannot be changed, this export remains blocked.

items.label: Samples in report
items.description: All currently scoped samples, including those with blocked tests.

items.label: Approved results checked
items.description: Assembled internal approved result rows. Subcontracted sources are separately marked unsupported.

items.label: Not yet checkable
items.description: Blocked tests plus sample-level blockers; not a count of unique samples. They need source resolution before their future approved data can be checked.

items.label: Sample_v5 / TestResultQC_v5 / Batch_v5
items.description: Counts of generated candidate sample, result/QC and batch-link rows, including supported laboratory QC. These are not saved files.

items.label: Findings you can act on now
items.description: Grouped causes that can be addressed before issue. Summary links group destinations and show finding/cause counts; use the table to see each affected record.

items.label: No findings in the checks possible now
items.description: Only the checks possible on present data passed. It is not a readiness guarantee; unapproved work, per-version context and reference-table values remain unverified.

items.label: Subcontracted results
items.description: Accepted external data can be reported in PDF but is unsupported by this NYSDEC exporter. It will block export rather than silently substitute this lab’s identity or omit it.

items.label: Needed after release
items.description: Location/depth, corrected-result test type and laboratory QC date/dilution belong to a specific released version. Listed as later context, not current findings; cannot be entered here before release.

items.label: Results not yet checkable
items.description: Readiness rows for test/sample problems blocking the report itself; use the source links and reload. No data limits have been tested for these missing results.

items.label: report preview
items.description: Return to the PDF/release workflow; this check does not issue anything.

sections.title: Finding columns and destinations
paragraphs: In this draft check, source-data findings can link to Sample record, Result record or Analyte catalog. Sample-ID/collector identity corrections require custodian or project-manager access and may be blocked once the sample is issued. The COC reference is fixed at order creation and is not correctable here. EDD setting links are omitted for readers without configuration access; a source link still enforces its own permissions. Findings marked Not correctable here require a decision outside this page.

items.label: Problem / Finding
items.description: Specific format or missing-data reason. Identical causes are grouped; grouping does not discard affected records.

items.label: Field
items.description: Recipient column affected, or a dash if not tied to one column.

items.label: Affected
items.description: Number of affected record entries for this cause. Counts are issues, not unique samples.

items.label: Records
items.description: Every affected sample/result/QC/settings record. Expand the first-record-and-more disclosure to see the full list.

items.label: Fix in
items.description: Destination that owns the correction: Project EDD codes, Test mapping, Qualifier mapping or Export context. A released-data problem needs corrected source work and a new issued version; changing live source data alone cannot fix the existing snapshot. Catalog corrections likewise need a new version. Not supported yet has no editable substitute.

sections.title: Limits of the check
paragraphs: Reference-table company, method, analyte, unit, matrix, fraction, preservative and qualifier codes need EQuIS EDP. Later approvals can introduce new findings. No approved results means no result data limits were checked, even if no findings are listed. Old issued versions and exports remain unchanged.
